pricingNote:
Investing in your health through private practice is a real financial decision, and if you are used to the NHS or a public healthcare system, the cost can feel like a significant shift. That hesitation is completely understandable. I want to be honest with you about what you are paying for and what you can expect in return.

Clinical herbal medicine and naturopathy take time — to understand your history properly, to formulate something specific to you, to adjust as your body responds. That depth is what makes it work. It is also what makes it different from a ten-minute appointment where you leave with a prescription and no real answers.

My prices currently reflect the early stage of my practice. I am transparent about that, and I will always be transparent when they change. I will also always offer a free discovery call before anything else, so you can understand what working together would actually look like before committing to anything.
commitment1: If you do not feel improvement after a genuine committed period of work together, I will not simply move on. We will look honestly at why — at what needs adjusting, what we might be missing, what your body is telling us that we have not yet heard properly. You will never be left wondering where you stand.
commitment2: And if at any point it becomes clear that I am not the right fit for you — whether that is about approach, specialism, or simply the dynamic between us — I will tell you honestly, and I will help you find someone who is better placed to support you. Your health matters more than my client list.

cancellationTiers.title: More than 48 hours
cancellationTiers.policy: Full refund by bank transfer, or rescheduling at no additional cost. Please notify me as soon as possible.

cancellationTiers.title: 24–48 hours
cancellationTiers.policy: 50% of the fee is retained. The remaining 50% will be returned to your bank account within 3–5 working days.

cancellationTiers.title: Less than 24 hours
cancellationTiers.policy: The full fee is retained. This slot was held for you and cannot be offered to someone else at short notice.

cancellationNote: Exceptions are made for genuine emergencies — please do get in touch. I understand that life happens.

faq.q: Do I need a referral or a GP's approval to see you?
faq.a: No. Herbal medicine and naturopathy are complementary disciplines and you do not need a referral or GP permission. I do ask that you disclose any current medications so I can check for herb-drug interactions — this is a clinical safety step, not a barrier to working together. If you are under specialist care for a serious condition, I will always work alongside that care, never in opposition to it.

faq.q: What happens in the initial consultation?
faq.a: We spend 90 minutes together (online or in person). I take a full case history: not just your symptoms, but your whole health picture, your energy patterns, your sleep, your stress, your digestion, your history. That depth is what makes a personalised protocol possible. Within 48 hours you receive a written protocol including herbal recommendations, naturopathic guidance, and any relevant lifestyle adjustments.

faq.q: How quickly will I see results?
faq.a: It depends on the condition and the person. Some clients notice significant shifts within two to four weeks — particularly with sleep, stress, and acute presentations. Chronic hormonal conditions like endometriosis and PCOS typically take three to six months to show meaningful improvement through herbal medicine. This is not a limitation, it is how the body actually heals. I will always be honest with you about realistic timescales.

faq.q: Do you work with clients who are on medication?
faq.a: Yes. Many of my clients are on medication, and herbal medicine works effectively alongside conventional treatment in most cases. I always conduct a thorough herb-drug interaction check as part of the initial consultation. There are some specific combinations I will not recommend. I will always explain clearly if that is the case and why. I never advise anyone to stop medication without consulting their prescribing doctor.

faq.q: Can I see you if I am outside the UK?
faq.a: Yes. Most of my consultations take place online, and I work with clients across the UK, France, Spain, Switzerland and beyond. I practise in both English and French. For herbal formulations, I can recommend trusted suppliers in your region, or we can discuss postal options depending on where you are.

faq.q: Do you offer a cancellation policy?
faq.a: I ask for 48 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice will be charged at 50% of the session fee. I understand that life happens — particularly when you are managing a health condition — and I always apply this with common sense and compassion.
